item.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike back in prison from hospital after failed execution
item.description: Christa Pike, a Tennessee death row inmate, has returned to prison after a failed execution attempt. The September 30 incident resulted in her needing medical care after the lethal injection process failed. Governor Bill Lee has ordered a review of the state's execution procedures following this incident. Pike had been sentenced to death for the 1995 murder of her classmate, Colleen Slemmer.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: State Seeks Missing Donations: New York AG sues teen’s relatives; raises oversight questions
item.description: Hailey Bodah, a young New Yorker, faced unimaginable loss when a fire claimed the lives of her father and four sisters. In the wake of this tragedy, generous relatives raised over $100,000 to help her. However, legal issues emerged regarding the management of the funds, with the New York Attorney General’s office demanding the return of over $71,000.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Steve McQueen’s former Malibu home sold for $7.2m in 2020; later renovated and listed for $16.995m
item.description: Steve McQueen's iconic Malibu beach house passed through several ownership hands before receiving significant renovations from its latest buyers. Boasting oceanfront decks and private beach access, this esteemed property is nestled within an exclusive gated community. Initially bought for $8.35 million, it was revamped and relisted at $16.995 million, eventually selling for $13.6 million in September 2023, with its connection to McQueen and MacGraw continuing to garner interest.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Couple Turn Ride Into Fundraiser: Utah pair cycle 3,634 miles in 87 days; raise about $23,000
item.description: A couple from Utah marked their 40th wedding anniversary with an epic cycling adventure across the United States, covering more than 3,600 miles in 87 days. Their mission was to raise awareness and funds for affordable housing and food assistance. Along the way, they navigated diverse terrains and overcame significant obstacles, bringing attention to the plight of families grappling with housing and food insecurity.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Why a $125 million Lake Tahoe ranch remains unsold
item.description: Shakespeare Ranch, a historic estate in Lake Tahoe, has struggled to find a buyer since listing. The property was initially priced at $188 million but has seen a price reduction to $125 million. Potential buyers are now interested in purchasing parts of the estate instead of the entire property. The main house, called Water’s Edge, is for sale at $39.5 million and features extensive amenities.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Ufo-Style Futuro Home Listed: Rare space-age house hits market; $1.495m price reflects preservation
item.description: Nestled in California's stunning landscape, the Donaldson Futuro is a captivating flying saucer-shaped home now listed for $1.495 million. Constructed in 1969, this architectural marvel exemplifies space-age design and carries historical weight. After languishing in neglect, it was expertly restored by Milford Wayne Donaldson, preserving its mid-century essence while integrating modern comforts. This is a unique opportunity to embrace a landmark of architectural history.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Florida cyber owner accused of misleading ransomware victims; firm charged $19M, secretly paid hackers $8M
item.description: Zohar Pinhasi, the owner of MonsterCloud, faces charges of wire fraud related to his cybersecurity business. Prosecutors allege he misrepresented his firm's capabilities to clients facing ransomware attacks. Instead of recovering data without ransom payment, he secretly paid attackers and charged clients significantly higher fees. Pinhasi allegedly collected over $19 million while paying more than $8 million in ransoms.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Craig Tiley loses $5.75 million on beachfront home sale
item.description: Craig Tiley's beachfront home in Aspendale was sold at a loss after he purchased it for $13.1 million. He listed the property for $11.5 million before reducing the price to $8.75 million. The final sale price of $7.35 million amounted to a financial loss of $5.75 million. Tiley also incurred an additional cost of $831,500 in stamp duty related to the sale.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Jane Fonda’s former home, once surveilled by the CIA, lists for $1.99M
item.description: Jane Fonda's iconic Hollywood Hills home, rooted in history and activism, is up for grabs at $1.99 million. This stunning Mediterranean Revival villa, built in 1932, reflects not only Fonda's journey but also the era's spirit. With five bedrooms and numerous amenities, it has been in the hands of Kathleen Whyte since 1985. Initially launched at $2.79 million in 2024, the price has now seen a significant cut.

item.title: 165-million-year-old fossil from China reveals mammal ancestor that swam and swallowed like mammals
item.description: Scientists have identified a 165-million-year-old mammal predecessor from China that had a broad tail for swimming and throat bones similar to those of modern mammals. Named Megacauda sungei, the Jurassic-era animal could chew and swallow food using specialised structures. Published in Nature, the findings offer new insights into how early mammals developed different feeding abilities.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Inside Luke Bryan’s 150-acre Tennessee farm with a rescue barn
item.description: Luke Bryan and his wife, Caroline Boyer, purchased a 150-acre farm in Williamson County, Tennessee, in 2012. They transformed it into Red Bird Farm, featuring a 10,000-square-foot main house, a guesthouse, and a party barn. The couple built a bass lake, which was a significant part of Bryan's childhood dream. Their farm also functions as a rescue space for animals under the Brett Boyer Foundation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Queens’ historic Lost Battalion Hall reopens after $25.9m reconstruction
item.description: Queens’ historic Lost Battalion Hall has reopened after a $25.9 million reconstruction. The 87-year-old recreation center now has upgraded fitness rooms, accessible facilities, modern safety systems and a refreshed basketball court.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dr Phil lists Beverly Hills estate for $67.5m after buying it for $29.8m
item.description: Dr. Phil McGraw and his wife Robin have put their luxurious Beverly Hills estate on the market for an impressive $67.5 million. After acquiring it for $29.8 million in 2010 and taking another seven years to complete its construction by 2011, the sprawling 16,079 square foot residence is accompanied by guest and staff quarters. Among its exquisite features are a swimming pool, wine cellar, and tennis court.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Listed at $8M, this 112-year-old home sells for $15M
item.description: At 2 Sixth Avenue in San Francisco, a remarkable house came onto the market with an asking price of $7.999 million but ultimately sold for a staggering $15 million. Having belonged to one family for seven decades, the well-appointed home includes four bedrooms and three bathrooms across 4,490 square feet.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk
